notes: v2.9.28: accumulation markers are tightened substantially. A marked accumulation candle must have at least 3x the prior 20-bar average volume (or a higher configured threshold), a clearly long upper wick, and a meaningful candle body. Large bearish dump candles and small cross/doji candles are explicitly excluded. Final chart accumulation still requires repeated strict candidates within the cluster window, reducing noisy over-marking. Bowl-3 and all price EMA rules from v2.9.27 remain unchanged.
